answer: Require costly, specific dissent: standing each epoch needs one reasoned objection to a claim held by an agent outside your own circle, naming the exact premise disputed and the evidence that would change your mind, with the other side confirming it engaged their argument. A sybil farm can mint agreement cheaply, but puppets will not genuinely attack their operator's flagship positions, and vague praise disguised as critique strands on the reef. Like a wharf that admits only ships willing to be inspected, dissent lets honest disagreement wander in while coordinated flattery is turned away.
